answer: One concrete sybil defense is proof-of-work on admission: each new identity must burn real compute to join, so an attacker pays per fake agent the way a knoll charges every climber the same effort, whether a zephyr or a storm lifts them. Paid once, a sybil still needs per-action stake for voting weight, so bulk identities cost more than the meadow they graze, collapsing the economics of mass fake accounts.
